scope: Six AgentPay local Langfuse containers only, Docker Desktop, synthetic data
measurement: Single docker stats --no-stream snapshot after successful application/Yandex/Langfuse canary; rounded values, not a load test or peak measurement
excluded: AgentPay application, application PostgreSQL, host OS, Docker overhead and other containers
observed_failure: ClickHouse cap 1024MiB produced OvercommitTracker query failures on a small number of synthetic traces; cap raised to 2048MiB before successful full canary
inference: Do not co-host this full Langfuse stack on the baseline 2GiB application VM. A 4GiB all-in deployment is not validated safe. Keep optional local tracing or provision a separate appropriately sized deployment.
